sections.question: ❓ What is Pippo Library?
sections.answer: Pippo Library is a curated collection of titles for jailbroken PS5 consoles, organized in exFAT format for easy download and installation.

sections.question: 💾 How do I install a game?
sections.answer: Download the title from the provided links, copy the format to a USB drive formatted in exFAT, and insert it into the PS5; they also work internally, including in the M2 slot. ShadowMountPlus is highly recommended.

sections.question: 📁 How to update .exFAT?
sections.answer: Simply use OSFMount or exFAT Image Builder, mount the format and replace what you need.

sections.question: 🪄 How can i fix the lag issue?
sections.answer: It all depends on the game's optimization. If there's an update for ampr-emu (Only APR titles), do it because it might help. Remember, exFAT or BackPort are never the problem.

sections.question: ❌ The game doesnt launch, what can i do?
sections.answer: Make sure you have a good external drive, such as an NVMe SSD; a low-quality SSD is often the cause of the problem. If that doesn’t help, move the .exFAT to an internal drive (ext1 or /data/homebrew). All the games in the catalog have been tested with offact + np-fake-signin on 9.00 (etaHEN with kstuff 1.09 and ShadowMountPlus, alternatively if you still use kstuff 1.6.7 then need Trophy Unlocker by soniciso), so you’ll never encounter games that won’t launch.

sections.question: ❌ Missing or invalid param.json, what can i do?
sections.answer: This usually happen when trying transfer the Content installed, for example usb0 to ext1, for fix this 1. Kill ShadowMountPlus payload 2. Uninstall the Content from Console (UI). 3. Restart the Console. Next time you launch ShadowMountPlus will install without any problems, perfect way to transfer the Contents: 1. Kill ShadowMountPlus payload 2. Uninstall the Content from the Console (UI) 3.Transfer the Content with PS5 Explorer (for example usb0 to ext1). 4. When the Content is succesfully transferred remove on the Drive (usb0) the Content. 5. Launch ShadowMountPlus and wait install the Content. 6. Restart the Console. Enjoy.

sections.question: 🔄 What does FW: 4.xx / 7.xx / 9.xx mean?
sections.answer: This indicates the minimum required PS5 firmware version. Select the filter that matches your version to see only compatible games. For example: if you have FW 4.03, you will see games for version 4.xx and lower.

sections.question: 📦 What are STANDARD and BACKPORT?
sections.answer: STANDARD is the original game, which requires firmware version 9.xx, for example. BACKPORT is a modified version designed to run on older firmware (e.g., 4.xx or lower).

sections.question: 🎮 How do you use DLCs?
sections.answer: Install the format first, then the DLCs.

sections.question: 🙏 How can I support the project?
sections.answer: You can support me on Ko-f or contribute to the community by reporting new games, backports, or fixes.

sections.question: 📱 Is the website optimized for mobile devices?
sections.answer: Yes! On smartphones, you'll see a hamburger menu and vertical filters. The carousel and grid adjust automatically.

sections.question: 🔐 Why is it asking for the password?
sections.answer: To protect the library from automated access and scraping, enter the password you received. Your session will remain active until you exit.

sections.question: ⚠️ I got an “Access Denied” message / Have I been flagged as a bot?
sections.answer: The anti-bot system is very sensitive. If you use a VPN, automated browsers, or browse too quickly, you may be temporarily blocked. Please refresh the page and wait a few minutes.

sections.question: ⚡ What is exFAT-Ripper used for?
sections.answer: A Windows/Linux app for browsing your library offline, featuring previews, metadata, and download management. You can find it all in the TOOLS section. If you’d like to suggest a feature or report an issue, please use the dedicated GitHub page (Issues).

sections.question: 🐴 What is pegasus-dl?
sections.answer: A tool that lets you download games directly to your PS5 without a PC. Click on TOOL → pegasus-dl for more information. If you’d like to suggest a feature or report an issue, please use the dedicated GitHub page (Issues).
